instruction.text: Anissa’s family stumbled upon an injured fish on the beach. Can you find the fish on the image?
It looks like the fish needs something fast! Select what the fish needs in the speech bubble.

feedback.finish: Anissa agrees. Fish need water to live, otherwise they cannot breathe.

instruction.text: Anissa’s mum decides to take care of the fish until it feels better. At home, her family gave the fish two of its needs. Select the two needs that the fish has been given in this image.
What is another of the fish’s needs? Listen to the options and select the correct answer.
Anissa notices that the fish keeps on swimming to the surface after being fed and begging for more food. Does the fish want or need more food?

feedback.finish: The fish may want more food but it doesn’t need more. Just like you may want ice cream for dessert but don’t need it.

instruction.text: Since the fish is no longer in danger, it would be happier returning to where it normally lives. Listen to the options and select where fish live.

feedback.finish: Anissa’s family did the right thing by returning the fish to the ocean. In nature, all its needs are taken care of, and the fish is used to its life there.
